MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

2. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 12

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 82

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 9

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
